class TypedFunctionFields {
  x=4;
  arrow=()=>this.x;
  explicit=function(this:TypedFunctionFields) { return this.x; };
  contextual:(this:{x:number})=>number=function() { return this.x; };
  nestedArrow=function(this:TypedFunctionFields) { return (()=>this.x)(); };
  static x=5;
  static arrow=()=>this.x;
}
const typedFields=new TypedFunctionFields();
console.log(typedFields.arrow(), typedFields.explicit(), typedFields.contextual(), typedFields.nestedArrow(), TypedFunctionFields.arrow());
function sameDefault(x=1) { var x=2; return x; }
function samePattern({x}:{x:number}) { var x=3; return x; }
const sameContextual:(x:number)=>number=function(x) { var x=4; return x; };
console.log(sameDefault(), samePattern({x:1}), sameContextual(1));
